evidence: decorative_mascot: Data only stands on things: on the right pan in hook@0.3 to seg0:end, on top of the 2024 bar in seg1:mid, and as two copies standing on lines in seg2:mid. In seg4:mid he walks along the bar, but no scene has a setup, action and payoff tied to the number.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start and seg3:mid show a balance scale with numbers caught mid-tween ('16.9' vs '152', then '26.5' vs '238'), which invites a viewer to read fake values. seg3:end then cuts to a nearly empty bar chart: two 'D'-shaped stubs, 'Today' and '30 years ago' labels, no values, and a large dead void.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene reuses the same balance-scale machine as the hook, then falls back to a bar chart whose bars have not grown yet. The 29 -> 260 counties claim (9x more places) is 'spread across the map', but it was drawn as 'weight'. Its closing state is also unfinished, so the frame is empty.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show 29 -> 260 high-risk counties as SPREAD, not weight: a US county grid or map where 29 cells light up, then the lit area floods out to 260. Or use a tick-cluster field that multiplies 9x across the frame. Final values should be visible at full size, and Data should do a bit tied to it, such as stepping back as the lit region reaches his feet. No mid-tween numbers on screen, and fill the frame.
